analyst.summary: Restaurant Brands Asia (Burger King India) continues to grow revenue but has not achieved sustained profitability, posting a net loss again this quarter and over the last full year, with a heavily reduced founding-promoter stake over time. A new investor, Inspira Global, has just taken a large 42% stake and injected Rs 1,050 crore of fresh capital -- a potentially significant development for the company's future that is too recent to fully assess. Based on the financials as they stand today we rate this a Sell, and flag the new-investor development for portfolio-manager review.
